system.description: Characters who approach supernatural power as a system that can be studied, constructed, and refined. Their actions create magical components that interact with later actions, building increasingly complex effects.
system.benefit: Gain access to the Magecraft Combat Skill. If acquired later: gain access to Magecraft, gain 2 pips in it, then gain one additional Magecraft Expertise and two additional Magecraft Action Cards.

origin.name: Elemental Versatility
origin.text: The first time you use an Action Card of a given element during an encounter, gain one additional Surge for that action.
